thread:
marta: Hey design folks — quick review request for the first-run flow update. Dropped new Figma frames and a short screen recording: https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/onboard-v3

I'm especially worried about the compact sample-project cards (do they feel discoverable?), whether the setup checklist is too heavy for first-run, quickstart banner copy, and any a11y/focus traps. Can folks skim and drop a quick :eyes: + one suggestion?

raj: Quick skim :eyes: — my 2¢: flatten the checklist to 2 required steps (Create sample project, Connect API key) and move advanced items into a 'More options' collapsible. Keeps first-run low friction. For cards: compact is fine but left-align title + one-line description so scanning works.

emma: +1 to raj. Accessibility nits: keyboard order on the sample cards is weird — tab jumps to the banner CTA before card actions. Need tab order to follow visual order. Also missing alt text on preview images (screen readers get silence).

aria_bot: Automated a11y scan results (quick): 2 contrast failures (primary button text vs bg), 3 images missing alt text, missing aria-live on success toast. See quick report: https://a11y.report/redwood/onboard-v3 (summary).

kevin: Copy thoughts: change primary CTA from 'Get started' -> 'Create a sample project'. Banner headline: 'Try a sample project — deploy in seconds'. Microcopy on API step: 'Connect your API key (you can rotate later)'. Also small CSS suggestion for focus: \n\n```css\n.card:focus {\n  outline: none;\n  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,120,220,0.15);\n}\n```\n\nmarta: Nice. Raj/Emma — can you quickly mock the collapse behavior and fix the focus order? I'd like to A/B test compact vs roomy cards. Proposed variant ids: onboard_v3_compact and onboard_v3_spacious. Can someone draft a tiny experiment spec (metrics/sample/length)?

raj: I'll do the mock. Experiment spec proposal: metric = "signup -> first API call" within 7 days; secondary = "time to first completion of checklist"; sample size = 2000 users per arm; run = 2 weeks; track clicks on "More options" and help CTA. Thoughts?

emma: Sounds good. For a11y I'll add ARIA roles: ensure sample-card actions are buttons with aria-labels, add aria-live=polite to the toast on successful API connect, and verify focus trap when the modal opens. Also will add automated voiceover checks in the test plan. Small note: Dismiss icons need visible text for screen readers.

kevin: I'll push the copy tweaks and produce the microcopy variants for the experiment (short vs explanatory). Also recommend a short tooltip on the API step: 'Why this? — required to make requests.'

marta: Owners: raj -> UX mocks + experiment spec, emma -> a11y fixes + test cases, kevin -> copy + microcopy variants. I'll file tickets and link them below. Please react with :thumbsup: once you own the item.

marta: Tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/UX-412 (mocks + experiment), https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/A11Y-89 (a11y fixes), https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/COPY-203 (microcopy variants).

raj: :thumbsup: I'll have mocks by EOD Friday.

emma: :thumbsup: I'll add tests to the a11y-suite and start manual QA on Monday.

kevin: :thumbsup: Will drop copy options in the doc and flag the preferred variants.

marta: thanks all — we'll review draft mocks + copy early next week in the product sync.
